extracted.name: Caprese sandwich
extracted.description: Load slices of focaccia with pesto, mozzarella, rocket, red onion and tomato. They're a perfect sandwich for feeding a crowd in a picnic.
ingredient_lines: 4 thick slices of focaccia or 8 slices of bread, to serve
2 tbsp basil pesto (ensure vegetarian, if needed)
2 x 125g balls of mozzarella sliced (ensure vegetarian, if needed)
instruction_lines: If using focaccia, cut the slices across the middle so you have a total of eight slices. Spread 1/4 tbsp pesto over four of the focaccia or bread slices, and drizzle each of the remaining four slices with 1/2 tsp olive oil.

Divide the rocket, mozzarella, tomatoes, basil leaves and red onion slices over the pesto-topped focaccia or bread. Drizzle 1/4 tsp balsamic vinegar over each of the remaining slices. Sandwich the slices together, wrap up for a picnic or serve straightaway. Best eaten on the day they’re made.
